statement: The phase2 refinement relation is mathematically defined for source and target payloads.
Every recognized source payload component has a declared target correspondence.
Correspondence is compatible with source and target canonicalization.
Each family-chain layer projection satisfies the selected refinement relation.
Layerwise refinements compose into whole-payload refinement.
The selected refinement relation preserves obstruction payload semantics.
Refinement preserves counterexample status where no reduction is needed.
If status is not preserved, a smaller witness is constructed.
The constructed smaller witness has strictly smaller support measure.
Failure of refinement or construction is routed to a named escape/blocker.
The phase2 relation/correspondence/construction inventories leave no untracked failure class.
